summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Antimachus the Trojan, whose sons Peisander and Hippolochus Agamemnon slew in the Iliad.

story.text: Apollodorus names Antimachus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Mecisteus and before Ptolemaeus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
